en.headline: Customs seizes HK$1.45m of drugs from two airport passengers
en.dek: Officers found suspected cannabis buds in a Bangkok arrival's carry-on bag and cocaine hidden in a Kuala Lumpur passenger's shoes; one man appears in court today.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it detected two separate trafficking cases at Hong Kong International Airport on Tuesday and Wednesday, seizing about 3.5 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds and one kilogram of suspected cocaine with a combined estimated market value of about HK$1.45 million.

In the first case, officers clearing a 61-year-old mainland woman who arrived from Bangkok on 15 September found the suspected cannabis buds, valued at about HK$700,000, in her carry-on suitcase. She was arrested. Customs said that investigation is continuing.

In the second case, a 29-year-old mainland man arriving from Kuala Lumpur on 16 September was found with about one kilogram of suspected cocaine, valued at about HK$750,000, concealed in the shoes he was wearing. He was arrested and charged with one count of trafficking in a dangerous drug. The case was due at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on Thursday.

Customs said trafficking in a dangerous drug carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment. The department again warned the public not to carry unknown items or accept payment to transport controlled goods into or out of Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢145萬元大麻花及可卡因 拘兩旅客
zh.dek: 海關連續兩日在機場檢獲約3.5公斤懸疑大麻花及1公斤懸疑可卡因；藏毒於鞋內的男子今在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
body: 香港海關表示，本月15日及16日在香港國際機場偵破兩宗入境旅客販毒案，檢獲約3.5公斤懸疑大麻花及約1公斤懸疑可卡因，估計市值共約145萬元。
首宗案件中，關員替一名由泰國曼谷抵港的61歲內地女旅客清關時，在其隨身行李發現市值約70萬元的懸疑大麻花，將她拘捕。海關指該案仍在調查。
第二宗案件中，一名29歲內地男旅客由馬來西亞吉隆坡抵港，關員在他所穿的鞋內發現重約1公斤、市值約75萬元的懸疑可卡因，將他拘捕，並控以一項販運危險藥物罪，案件周四在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
海關提醒，根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物最高可被判罰款500萬元及終身監禁，呼籲市民不要為金錢運送來歷不明物品進出香港。
